mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day returns in low FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the signal fails to outperform the market in 3 consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A rising PAYEMS combined with a falling UNRATE indicates labor market tightening, signaling strong economic growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling fails to produce positive returns in > 40% of cases over a 3-year window, or the correlation between the signal and returns is negative.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, housing starts above 750 thousand units signal robust consumer demand, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 750 and the regime is late-cycle expansion, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 5.0% signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the signal's predictive power is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) is rising and the federal funds rate is low (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), it signals potential central bank easing, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails to produce positive returns in > 40% of cases over a 3-year window, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 95.0 signals weakening supply, reducing corporate earnings and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0, or the signal's predictive power is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales above 410,000 million dollars signal strong consumer spending, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when RSAFS > 410,000, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.02.
